## KinetixFitt Change Review

### What changed?
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Refactor
- [ ] Performance
- [ ] Security
- [ ] Database
- [ ] Payments
- [ ] AI
- [ ] Platform/deployment
- [ ] Documentation

### Impact
Describe affected apps, packages, routes, APIs, database models, external services, and platforms.

### Regression check
- [ ] Existing consumers were searched.
- [ ] Existing tests were reviewed.
- [ ] No unrelated functionality was removed.
- [ ] No parallel implementation was introduced.

### Data / API
- [ ] No schema change.
- [ ] Migration included and tested.
- [ ] API contract unchanged.
- [ ] API contract intentionally changed and consumers updated.

### Security
- [ ] No secrets committed.
- [ ] Authorization checked server-side.
- [ ] Sensitive input validated.
- [ ] Relevant security tests pass.

### Verification
- [ ] Lint
- [ ] Typecheck
- [ ] Relevant unit/integration tests
- [ ] Security tests, when applicable
- [ ] Build
- [ ] E2E, when applicable
- [ ] Preview/deployment checked, when applicable

### Rollback
Explain how to revert the application and how database compatibility is preserved.

### Evidence
Add exact commands/results or links to CI/preview evidence.

### Known limitations
List anything still partial, blocked by external credentials, or intentionally deferred.
